texts.NIV84: The LORD abhors dishonest scales, but accurate weights are his delight.
texts.KJV: A false balance is abomination to the Lord: but a just weight is his delight.
texts.NKJV:
Dishonest scales are an abomination to the Lord,
But a just weight is His delight.
texts.DRB: A deceitful balance is an abomination before the Lord: and a just weight is his will.

texts.NIV84: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.
texts.KJV: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
texts.NKJV:
When pride comes, then comes shame;
But with the humble is wisdom.
texts.DRB: Where pride is, there also shall be reproach: but where humility is, there also is wisdom.

texts.NIV84: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.
texts.KJV: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
texts.NKJV:
The integrity of the upright will guide them,
But the perversity of the unfaithful will destroy them.
texts.DRB: The simplicity of the just shall guide them: and the deceitfulness of the wicked shall destroy them.

texts.NIV84: Wealth is worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
texts.KJV: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
texts.NKJV:
Riches do not profit in the day of wrath,
But righteousness delivers from death.
texts.DRB: Riches shall not profit in the day of revenge: but justice shall deliver from death.

texts.NIV84: The righteousness of the blameless makes a straight way for them, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.
texts.KJV: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
texts.NKJV:
The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way aright,
But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.
texts.DRB: The justice of the upright shall make his way prosperous: and the wicked man shall fall by his own wickedness.

texts.NIV84: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.
texts.KJV: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
texts.NKJV:
The righteousness of the upright will deliver them,
But the unfaithful will be caught by their lust.
texts.DRB: The justice of the righteous shall deliver them: and the unjust shall be caught in their own snares.

blocks.title: The Righteous is Delivered from Trouble

texts.NIV84: When a wicked man dies, his hope perishes; all he expected from his power comes to nothing.
texts.KJV: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
texts.NKJV:
When a wicked man dies, his expectation will perish,
And the hope of the unjust perishes.
texts.DRB: When the wicked man is dead, there shall be no hope any more: and the expectation of the solicitous shall perish.

texts.NIV84: The righteous man is rescued from trouble, and it comes on the wicked instead.
texts.KJV: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
texts.NKJV:
The righteous is delivered from trouble,
And it comes to the wicked instead.
texts.DRB: The just is delivered out of distress: and the wicked shall be given up for him.

texts.NIV84: With his mouth the godless destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous escape.
texts.KJV: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
texts.NKJV:
The hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbor,
But through knowledge the righteous will be delivered.
texts.DRB: The dissembler with his mouth deceiveth his friend: but the just shall be delivered by knowledge.

texts.NIV84: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.
texts.KJV: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
texts.NKJV:
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices;
And when the wicked perish, there is jubilation.
texts.DRB: When it goeth well with the just the city shall rejoice: and when the wicked perish there shall be praise.

texts.NIV84: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.
texts.KJV: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
texts.NKJV:
By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted,
But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
texts.DRB: By the blessing of the just the city shall be exalted: and by the mouth of the wicked it shall be overthrown.

blocks.title: A Man of Understanding Holds His Peace

texts.NIV84: A man who lacks judgment derides his neighbor, but a man of understanding holds his tongue.
texts.KJV: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
texts.NKJV:
He who is devoid of wisdom despises his neighbor,
But a man of understanding holds his peace.
texts.DRB: He that despiseth his friend, is mean of heart: but the wise man will hold his peace.

texts.NIV84: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy man keeps a secret.
texts.KJV: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
texts.NKJV:
A talebearer reveals secrets,
But he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter.
texts.DRB: He that walketh deceitfully, revealeth secrets: but he that is faithful, concealeth the thing committed to him by his friend.

texts.NIV84: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but many advisers make victory sure.
texts.KJV: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
texts.NKJV:
Where there is no counsel, the people fall;
But in the multitude of counselors there is safety.
texts.DRB: Where there is no governor, the people shall fall: but there is safety where there is much counsel.

texts.NIV84: He who puts up security for another will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to strike hands in pledge is safe.
texts.KJV: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
texts.NKJV:
He who is surety for a stranger will suffer,
But one who hates being surety is secure.
texts.DRB: He shall be afflicted with evil, that is surety for a stranger: but he that is aware of the snares, shall be secure.

blocks.title: A Gracious Woman and A Merciful Man

texts.NIV84: A kindhearted woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
texts.KJV: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
texts.NKJV:
A gracious woman retains honor,
But ruthless men retain riches.
texts.DRB: A gracious woman shall find glory: and the strong shall have riches.

texts.NIV84: A kind man benefits himself, but a cruel man brings trouble on himself.
texts.KJV: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
texts.NKJV:
The merciful man does good for his own soul,
But he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.
texts.DRB: A merciful man doth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel casteth off even his own kindred.

texts.NIV84: The wicked man earns deceptive wages, but he who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
texts.KJV: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
texts.NKJV:
The wicked man does deceptive work,
But he who sows righteousness will have a sure reward.
texts.DRB: The wicked maketh an unsteady work: but to him that soweth justice, there is a faithful reward.

texts.NIV84: The truly righteous man attains life, but he who pursues evil goes to his death.
texts.KJV: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
texts.NKJV:
As righteousness leads to life,
So he who pursues evil pursues it to his own death.
texts.DRB: Clemency prepareth life: and the pursuing of evil things, death.

texts.NIV84: The LORD detests men of perverse heart but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.
texts.KJV: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the Lord: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
texts.NKJV:
Those who are of a perverse heart are an abomination to the Lord,
But the blameless in their ways are His delight.
texts.DRB: A perverse heart is abominable to the Lord: and his will is in them that walk sincerely.

texts.NIV84: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.
texts.KJV: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
texts.NKJV:
Though they join forces, the wicked will not go unpunished;
But the posterity of the righteous will be delivered.
texts.DRB: Hand in hand the evil man shall not be innocent: but the seed of the just shall be saved.

blocks.title: The Righteous Desire is Only Good

texts.NIV84: Like a gold ring in a pig's snout is a beautiful woman who shows no discretion.
texts.KJV: As a jewel of gold in a swine's snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
texts.NKJV:
As a ring of gold in a swine’s snout,
So is a lovely woman who lacks discretion.
texts.DRB: A golden ring in a swine's snout, a woman fair and foolish.

texts.NIV84: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.
texts.KJV: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
texts.NKJV:
The desire of the righteous is only good,
But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
texts.DRB: The desire of the just is all good: the expectation of the wicked is indignation.

texts.NIV84: One man gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.
texts.KJV: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
texts.DRB: Some distribute their own goods, and grow richer: others take away what is not their own, and are always in want.

texts.NIV84: A generous man will prosper; he who refreshes others will himself be refreshed.
texts.KJV: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
texts.NKJV:
The generous soul will be made rich,
And he who waters will also be watered himself.
texts.DRB: The soul which blesseth, shall be made fat: and he that inebriateth, shall be inebriated also himself.

texts.NIV84: People curse the man who hoards grain, but blessing crowns him who is willing to sell.
texts.KJV: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
texts.NKJV:
The people will curse him who withholds grain,
But blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.
texts.DRB: He that hideth up corn, shall be cursed among the people: but a blessing upon the head of them that sell.

blocks.title: Fruit of the Righteous is a Tree of Life

texts.NIV84: He who seeks good finds goodwill, but evil comes to him who searches for it.
texts.KJV: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
texts.NKJV:
He who earnestly seeks good finds favor,
But trouble will come to him who seeks evil.
texts.DRB: Well doth he rise early who seeketh good things; but he that seeketh after evil things shall be oppressed by them.

texts.NIV84: Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.
texts.KJV: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
texts.NKJV:
He who trusts in his riches will fall,
But the righteous will flourish like foliage.
texts.DRB: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the just shall spring up as a green leaf.

texts.NIV84: He who brings trouble on his family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.
texts.KJV: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
texts.NKJV:
He who troubles his own house will inherit the wind,
And the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.
texts.DRB: He that troubleth his own house, shall inherit the winds: and the fool shall serve the wise.

texts.NIV84: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
texts.KJV: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
texts.NKJV:
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life,
And he who wins souls is wise.
texts.DRB: The fruit of the just man is a tree of life: and he that gaineth souls, is wise.

texts.NIV84: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
texts.KJV: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
texts.NKJV:
If the righteous will be recompensed on the earth,
How much more the ungodly and the sinner.
texts.DRB: If the just man receive in the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner.
